subjects.faerie: A tiny adult faerie with dragonfly wings, long antennae and glossy black eyes stands on a giant flower stem. One wing is torn and bleeding. A crushed flower-cup home lies beside her. Meadow of giant blossoms at dawn, pink and gold. Camera: macro, low among the stems.
subjects.eladrin-2014: An adult autumn eladrin with copper-red hair, long pointed ears and bright fey eyes appears mid-teleport in a swirl of falling red leaves, dragging a bleeding adult companion. Feywild glade of crimson and gold trees, clear sky. Camera: wide, eye level.
subjects.drow: An adult drow with dark violet-grey skin and white hair steps out of a cave mouth into blinding noon sun on an alpine meadow, shading her eyes, a bloody gash on her arm. Fresh blue and green palette. Camera: from inside the cave looking out.
subjects.shadar-kai-2014: An adult shadar-kai, gaunt, ash-pale skin, black hair braided with raven feathers, kneels among silver dead trees on a lavender twilight moor, closing the eyes of a fallen adult. Ravens circle. Violet and teal palette, never grey. Camera: low, over the shoulder.

subjects.duergar-2014: An adult duergar, grey skin, bald head, long white beard, swells to giant size in a psionic surge inside a cavern forest of huge teal glowing mushrooms. A crushed mine cart and a bleeding adult miner lie nearby. Camera: low, looking up.
subjects.yuan-ti-pureblood: An adult yuan-ti pureblood, human-looking but with slit snake eyes, green scale patches on neck and hands and a forked tongue, climbs sunlit jungle ziggurat steps with calm snakes around his feet. A wounded adult pilgrim rests on a step. Emerald and gold. Camera: high angle down the steps.
subjects.dreamer: An adult Dreamer just woken from a cracked crystal stasis pod, frost and dust on ancient ornate robes, blinking at bright overgrown ruins. Other pods are shattered with dead sleepers inside. Jade and amber palette. Camera: inside the vault looking out.
subjects.downcast: An adult Downcast, a fallen angel living as a mortal: faint broken halo, golden eyes, bandaged back with fresh blood where wings were cut, harvesting wheat. Golden field, wide blue sky. Camera: wide, from behind the wheat.

subjects.dhakaani-ghaaldar: An adult hobgoblin warrior with red-orange skin in disciplined bronze-plated armor holds formation with a war band on a red stone mountain fortress wall. A wounded adult soldier is carried behind. Camera: wide, along the wall.
subjects.dhakaani-golindar: A small adult goblin artisan with yellow-green skin hammers blue steel in an underground Dhakaani forge lit by teal crystals and white sparks. A burned adult apprentice sits with a bandaged hand. Camera: close, from the anvil.
subjects.dhakaani-guuldar: An adult bugbear with very long arms and shaggy brown fur reaches over a log palisade in a snowy pine forest at bright morning, pulling a bleeding adult ally to safety. Camera: low, outside the palisade.
subjects.jhorguntaal: An adult half-orc druid of the Shadow Marches, green-grey skin, bone and feather charms, wades a bright green bayou with mangroves and white herons, carrying a wounded adult tribe member. Camera: eye level from the water.

subjects.kalamer-landwalker: An adult merfolk on a white beach mid-change, her shimmering blue tail splitting into legs, an adult islander helping her stand while another lies bleeding by a broken canoe. Turquoise lagoon, palm islands. Camera: wide, low on the sand.
subjects.ruinbound: An adult humanoid with an iridescent purple alien symbiont grown over one arm and shoulder, pulsing, stands in bright sunlit ancient alien ruins of twisted stone. A dead adult explorer lies nearby. Camera: medium, slightly low.
subjects.nautilid: An adult cephalopod-headed humanoid in a bulky brass diving suit filled with green liquid stands on the open deck of a spiral-shelled sailing ship among bright pink and blue nebula clouds. A wounded adult crewmate grips a rope. Camera: wide, from the mast.
subjects.amoeboid: An adult translucent gelatinous humanoid, half of its body copying the shape of a nearby adult merchant, in a crowded bright starport market with hanging lanterns and blue sky dome. A bleeding adult guard lies by a toppled stall. Camera: medium, eye level.

subjects.geppettin: An adult-sized living marionette with carved wooden joints and a cracked porcelain face, cut strings hanging from its wrists, sits in a sunny toymaker's workshop full of half-made puppets. The old adult toymaker lies wounded on the floor. Camera: medium, low.
subjects.manikin: An adult-sized jointed mannequin construct with two daggers set into its forearms stands backstage of a bright painted theater, red curtains, an adult actor bleeding on the boards. Camera: from the wings.
subjects.wechselkind: A small doll-like adult Wechselkind with a cracked porcelain face and old, tired adult eyes sits on a sunlit attic windowsill of an old manor, dust motes, broken furniture. Adult figures argue below in the garden. Camera: inside the attic.
subjects.vect: An adult humanoid robot of segmented blue-white plates, panels opening as it rearranges itself, works in a bright starship engine room with glowing cyan coils. An injured adult engineer leans on a rail. Camera: wide, over the railing.

subjects.mandrake: An adult mandrake, a plant humanoid with a root-woven body and spring-green leaves for hair, stands in a bright sunflower field beside a burned barn, a wounded adult farmer at its feet. Camera: low among the sunflowers.
subjects.accursed: An adult Accursed with one arm blackened and cracked with glowing red veins stands at a bright spring crossroads under an empty gallows, villagers keeping their distance, a bloody bandage on the cursed hand. Camera: wide, eye level.
subjects.arisen: An adult Arisen, a made body of mismatched limbs with fresh sutures, sits up on a stone table in a sunlit tower laboratory with tall windows and hanging herbs. The adult creator lies dead on the floor. Camera: high angle.
subjects.disembodied: A blurred, hazy, translucent adult ghost stands beside their own fresh grave in a sunny hillside cemetery of white stones and wildflowers, mourners not seeing them. Camera: medium, from among the graves.

subjects.grudgel: An adult grudgel, stocky and broad-shouldered with grey-green skin, heavy brow and small tusks, stands calm and disciplined, holding a broken shield over a wounded adult comrade on a sunny rocky pass. Camera: low, from the rocks.
subjects.laneshi: An adult Laneshi, an amphibious deep-sea humanoid with gills, webbed hands and glowing blue markings, wades out of a sunlit tidal cave carrying a drowned adult fisher. Turquoise and coral palette. Camera: from inside the cave.
subjects.ogresh: A large, friendly adult Ogresh, twice human height, lifts a fallen roof beam off a collapsed bright village tavern while adult townsfolk pull a bleeding man free. Camera: wide, eye level.
subjects.wulven: An adult Wulven, cursed with wolf traits, partly furred, lupine ears and muzzle, golden eyes, sits ashamed in a snowy pine forest under a bright blue moonlit sky beside torn bloody snow. Camera: medium, low.

subjects.cursed-blood: A small adult Cursed-Blood clings to a sunlit cliff wall, a ghostly face of their dead twin glowing faintly from their stomach. Below, a ruined bright hamlet and a wounded adult. Camera: side view on the cliff.
subjects.demidritch: An adult Demidritch, skin like a starry nebula, one huge cosmic eye opening on the forehead, stands on a bright mountain observatory balcony, a bleeding adult astronomer at their feet. Camera: low, over the balcony rail.
subjects.scourgeborne: An adult Scourgeborne with spider traits, extra small eyes, dark chitin plates and long fingers, crouches in a bright forest of white webs and green ferns, freeing a webbed bleeding adult traveller. Camera: medium, low.
subjects.wrothian: An adult Wrothian, a lean predator humanoid with razor claws, sharp teeth and a faint violet psionic glow around the head, stands in a bright alien canyon of orange and teal stone, a fallen adult rival at its feet. Camera: wide.

subjects.pluvenn: An adult Pluvenn, a feathered raptor-like dinosaur folk with large curved hand claws, crouches on a fern-covered riverbank in a bright prehistoric valley, a wounded adult hunter beside. Camera: low in the ferns.
subjects.manyhorn: An adult Manyhorn, a muscular horned ceratopsian folk with a wide head crest, hauls a cart from a mudslide in a bright jungle trade town while guild workers pull out an injured adult. Camera: wide.
subjects.jeholrak: A small adult Jeholrak, a slim feathered dinosaur folk with a bright crest and hypnotic eyes, whispers to a dazed adult in a colorful canopy market while a bleeding rival lies hidden behind stalls. Camera: high angle.
subjects.ankylier: An adult Ankylier, an armored ankylosaur folk with a clubbed tail, braces against a falling stone wall in a bright savanna village, shielding adult villagers, blood on its plates. Camera: low.

subjects.limukin: An adult Limukin, a small swift lizard-like hunter with venom-coated spear, stalks through a bright misty fern forest beside a wounded adult companion. Camera: medium, through the ferns.
subjects.child-of-seth: An adult Child of Seth, a pterosaur folk with leathery membrane wings and a long head crest, glides over bright sea cliffs, carrying a bleeding adult. Camera: wide, from the cliff top.
subjects.avia-ra: An adult Avia-Ra, a falcon-headed humanoid sun priest in white and gold, raises a hand of healing light in a bright desert temple courtyard over a wounded adult pilgrim. Camera: low, from the temple steps.
subjects.skathari: An adult Skathari, an insectoid humanoid with a glossy shell, hooked claws and membranous gliding wings, glides between floating asteroid rocks against a bright violet and blue nebula, a wounded adult crewmate on a rock. Camera: wide.

subjects.cervan: An adult Cervan, a deer-folk with antlers and soft brown fur, kneels to bandage a bleeding adult in a bright birch forest clearing beside a burned cart. Camera: medium, eye level.
subjects.gallus: An adult Gallus, a proud pheasant-like birdfolk with bright copper and green plumage, flaps up onto a village rooftop to signal, while below adult villagers carry a wounded neighbour. Camera: wide, from the street.
subjects.hedge: A small adult Hedge, hedgehog-folk with brown quills, curls into a spiky ball to shield a wounded adult friend in a bright mossy burrow entrance among roots. Camera: low.
subjects.jerbeen: A small adult Jerbeen, jerboa-folk with long hind legs and big ears, leaps across a bright sandy canyon gap carrying a satchel of bandages to wounded adults. Camera: wide, side view.

subjects.luma: A small adult Luma, a bright songbird folk with jewel-blue feathers, sings over a wounded adult in a sunlit blossom tree village. Camera: medium, in the branches.
subjects.mapach: An adult Mapach, raccoon-folk with masked face and ringed tail, builds a makeshift splint from scrap in a bright junkyard market for an injured adult. Camera: close, eye level.
subjects.raptor: A small adult Raptor, hawk-folk with keen eyes and banded wings, perches on a bright cliff lookout, spotting smoke from a burning village far below, a bloody talon. Camera: over the shoulder.
subjects.strig: An adult Strig, owl-folk with tufted ears and huge amber eyes, reads by daylight in a ruined bright library, a wounded adult scholar beside. Camera: medium, low.

subjects.vulpin: An adult Vulpin, fox-folk with red fur and a sly smile, offers a hand to a wounded adult in a bright autumn orchard with a looted cart. Camera: medium, eye level.
subjects.feathren: An adult Feathren, a feline folk with feathered wings and jay-blue feathers mixed into lion fur, guards a mountain shrine in bright morning light over a fallen adult. Camera: low.
